title: Send feedback in the admin panel: choose its shape
question: Send feedback sits just above Account at the bottom left. You chose: offer Capture this page, thanks and close, no list of what you've sent. Lock one, steer it, or ask for another hand.

options.label: The page is the screenshot
options.thesis: Send feedback asks to capture the page you're on first, then the work area becomes the composer: the capture large on the left, your words on the right.
options.viewport: Sidebar stays; the work area turns into a sand stage holding 'This page, captured' at large size with a strip of other files under it, and Send feedback with Tell us about it, Sent with it and Send on the right.
options.risk: Every open starts with the browser's share-this-tab prompt; someone who only wants to type a sentence has to say no to it first (it would offer to skip).

options.label: A sheet over the page
options.thesis: The same sheet as Jump to: near the top of the window over a dim scrim, with Capture this page and Choose files, a drop and paste frame, the words, and Send.
options.viewport: Dimmed Media page; a 600px sheet: Send feedback, a lead, Capture this page and Choose files, two chosen thumbnails beside 'Paste ⌘V or drop', Tell us about it, Sent with it, Cancel and Send.
options.risk: Familiar but blocks the page while open, so you can't look back at the problem without closing it (what you've typed and chosen stays).

options.label: Rises from the sidebar
options.thesis: A small card grows up from the Send feedback row and stays beside it; the page isn't dimmed, so you can keep looking, scrolling and dropping files onto it.
materials: small This page and Files tiles
options.viewport: Media page untouched; a 420px card at the bottom left pointing at Send feedback: the words field first, a row of a chosen thumbnail, This page and Files tiles, 'or paste ⌘V / drop anywhere', Sent with it, and Send.
options.risk: Small: screenshots show as thumbnails only, and the card covers part of the page's lower left while open.
